user.title: Packing lists
user.description: Creates a master packing list and lets you build a packing list for each trip from it.

data.seed_master: Start with a suggested master list

abort.single_instance_allowed: Packing lists are already set up.

create_list.name: Create packing list
create_list.description: Creates a new packing list and fills it from the master list.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: Add all master items with any of these tags.

categories.name: Categories
categories.description: Add all master items in these categories.

items.name: Items
items.description: Add these master items (summary or uid).

add_from_master.name: Add from master
add_from_master.description: Adds items from the master list to a packing list. Items already on the list are skipped.

entity_id.name: Packing list
entity_id.description: The packing list to add to.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: Add all master items with any of these tags.

categories.name: Categories
categories.description: Add all master items in these categories.

items.name: Items
items.description: Add these master items (summary or uid).

include_excluded.name: Include deleted
include_excluded.description: Also add items that were deleted from the list before.

add_master_items.name: Add to master
add_master_items.description: Adds one or more items to the master list sharing category and tags. Existing names get the new tags, and are moved to the category if listed in 'Move'.

items.name: Items
items.description: Names of the items (a list, or one per line).

category.name: Category
category.description: Category for all the items, e.g. Clothes.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: Tags for all the items, e.g. summer, beach.

move.name: Move
move.description: Existing items that should be moved to the category.

reset_list.name: Clear checkmarks
reset_list.description: Unchecks every item on the packing list, so everything is not packed.

delete_list.name: Delete packing list
delete_list.description: Deletes the packing list and its entities.

update_master_item.name: Update master item
update_master_item.description: Changes name, category and/or tags of a master list item. Category and tags are also updated on packing lists.

item.name: Item
item.description: Name or uid of the item.

category.name: Category
category.description: New category. Empty removes it, omitted keeps it.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: New tags (replace the old ones). Empty list removes all tags, omitted keeps them.

reset_master.name: Reset master list
reset_master.description: Replaces the whole master list with the default list. Packing lists are not affected.

refresh_list.name: Fetch again
refresh_list.description: Adds new master items matching the list's tags and categories. Items deleted from the list are not brought back.

include_excluded.name: Include deleted
include_excluded.description: Also add items that were deleted from the list before.

add_list_item.name: Add item to packing list
add_list_item.description: Adds an item to a packing list with category and tags, optionally also saving it on the master list.

add_to_master.name: Also save in master
add_to_master.description: Also save the item on the master list.

copy_to_master.name: Save in master
copy_to_master.description: Saves a packing list item on the master list and links them. If the name exists, that item gets the new tags.

item.name: Item
item.description: Name or uid of the item on the packing list.

category.name: Category
category.description: Category in the master (omitted = the item's own).

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: Tags in the master (omitted = the item's own).

not_loaded.message: Packing lists is not set up.

master_item_not_found.message: {item} is not on the master list.

list_item_not_found.message: {item} is not on the packing list.
